staged_defects.declaration: This defect is staged for this benchmark task against pinned JustRL-II @ 75814318, not an unpatched upstream bug. Upstream at this commit computes local moments directly inside miles/utils/distributed_utils.py::distributed_masked_whiten without MomentReducer; evaluations/solution/oracle/fix.diff removes the cached _origins buffer from miles/utils/moments.py::MomentReducer and allocates a fresh zero origin tensor per call.

miles/utils/process_group_compat.py and miles/backends/megatron_utils/actor.py (ReloadableProcessGroup unwrap forwarder and Megatron collective bindings for PyTorch 2.13)

miles/backends/sglang_utils/sglang_engine.py, miles/backends/megatron_utils/update_weight/update_weight_from_distributed/mixin.py, and update_weight_from_tensor.py (begin_weight_update / end_weight_update protocol for SGLang 0.5.20.dev59)
miles/utils/tracking_utils/__init__.py and miles/ray/rollout.py (MILES_METRICS_FILE and MILES_EVAL_DUMP_DIR JSONL hooks)
miles/backends/training_utils/loss.py (strip leftover [adv-diag] debug logs, guard empty local CP shard in logdiff metrics, and use per-prompt-group DP whitening across microbatches)
run_justrl2_ppo.sh, data_prep/countdown.py, and reward/countdown_reward.py (single-node 8-GPU CP2xDP2 Countdown PPO harness)
workspace/.gitignore (anchor /models/, /datasets/, /runs/ so miles_plugins/models/ and fsdp_utils/models/ are tracked)
